title: The Star That Sends Us Death Warnings
hook: Every 12 years, a star 640 light-years away pulses a signal that perfectly mirrors the pattern of a countdown — and we just decoded the next arrival date.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines pattern recognition paranoia with an impending date — viewers will feel a personal countdown.

title: The Asteroid That Evaded NASA's Radar for 50 Years
hook: In 2023, a rock the size of a stadium silently passed between Earth and the Moon — and NASA only spotted it 48 hours later.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reveals a humiliating blind spot in planetary defense — triggers fear of the one we won't see.

title: The Secret U.S. Satellite That Watches Nukes from Space
hook: There's a classified satellite 22,000 miles above Earth that can read a license plate from orbit — and its true mission was buried for decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into paranoia about government surveillance from above — feels like a conspiracy confirmed.

title: The Supernova That Will Blind Earth in 2040
hook: Astronomers have identified a binary star system destined to explode — and when it does, the flash will temporarily blind every eye on the planet.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gives a specific future date — audiences love countdowns to cosmic catastrophe.

title: The Black Hole That Eats Stars for Breakfast
hook: A supermassive black hole 200 million light-years away has been caught shredding a star every 22 days — and it's speeding up.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personifies the black hole as a hungry predator — visceral and terrifying.

title: The Dark Planet That Shouldn't Exist
hook: Astronomers found a rogue world drifting alone in deep space with no sun — and its temperature is colder than the cosmic microwave background.
why_this_can_go_viral: Defies the laws of physics — viewers will ask 'how can something be colder than space itself?'

title: The CIA's Space Weapon That Never Got Built
hook: In the 1960s, the CIA designed a nuclear-powered satellite that could vaporize entire cities from orbit — only a single treaty stopped it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Declassified details about a weapon of mass destruction — taps into forbidden knowledge and cold war paranoia.

title: The Signal That Traveled 8 Billion Years to Kill Us
hook: A fast radio burst from the edge of the observable universe carried more energy than the Sun emits in 100 years — and it's aimed directly at Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Pairs unfathomable distance with a directed threat — feels like a cosmic sniper.

title: The Invisible Barrier That Surrounds the Solar System
hook: NASA's Voyager probes found a wall of fire at the edge of our solar system — and something is pushing back against it from the outside.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests we're trapped inside a bubble — triggers claustrophobia and curiosity about what's outside.

title: The Doomsday Clock Asteroid That Changes Orbit Every Year
hook: Asteroid Bennu has a 1-in-2700 chance of hitting Earth in 2182 — but its orbit keeps shifting, and NASA doesn't know why.
why_this_can_go_viral: Adds mystery to a known threat — people love the idea that the asteroid is 'alive' or being pushed.

title: The Star That Steals Planets from Other Systems
hook: A hypervelocity star is racing through the galaxy at 2 million mph — and it's dragging stolen exoplanets in its wake.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personifies the star as a cosmic thief — high visual drama and scientific mystery.

title: The Dark Matter Cloud That Could Collapse Our Sun
hook: A dense clump of dark matter is drifting toward the solar system — if it hits the Sun, it could trigger a fatal implosion.
why_this_can_go_viral: Turns dark matter from abstract to imminent — viewers will fear something they can't see.

title: The Alien Signal That Stopped When We Answered
hook: In 1977, the Wow! Signal was received. In 2012, a similar signal came from the same spot — but the moment we sent a reply, silence fell forever.
why_this_can_go_viral: Perfect horror setup — we spoke first and they went quiet. Implies we made a mistake.

title: The Glacier That Holds Alien Life from Another World
hook: Microbes found deep in Antarctic ice match the chemistry of Jupiter's moon Europa — and they're not supposed to exist on Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Blurs the line between Earth and alien — suggests extraterrestrial life is already here.

title: The Soviet Space Station That Went Dark Forever
hook: In 1985, Salyut 7 went silent for 3 months. When cosmonauts docked, they found it covered in something no one could explain.
why_this_can_go_viral: Classified Soviet space incident with eerie details — feels like an episode of unsolved mysteries.

title: The Neutron Star That Pulses a Death Ray Every 1.4 Seconds
hook: A rotating neutron star in the Milky Way sweeps a beam of radiation across the galaxy — and Earth is about to enter its kill zone.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gives a ticking clock — viewers will wonder when Earth enters the beam.

title: The Void That Is Eating the Universe from Inside
hook: The Boötes Void is a region of space 330 million light-years across with almost no stars — and it's growing faster than it should.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a 'hole' in the universe that expands is deeply unsettling and visually powerful.

title: The Planet That Orbits a Dead Star's Graveyard
hook: Astronomers found a Jupiter-sized world orbiting a white dwarf — the charred remains of its sun. It shouldn't have survived the star's death.
why_this_can_go_viral: A planet that 'should be dead' — spooky and mysterious, like a cosmic ghost story.

title: The Hidden Army of Rogue Black Holes in the Milky Way
hook: There are 100 million black holes drifting through our galaxy — and one passes within a light-year of Earth every 100,000 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Numbers game — 100 million invisible killers in our backyard. Scale creates dread.

title: The Moon That Suddenly Started Screaming at Earth
hook: Saturn's moon Enceladus began erupting plumes of water vapor in 2005 — and the signal it emits sounds like a scream when converted to audio.
why_this_can_go_viral: Auditory horror — converting space data to sound makes it feel alive and angry.

title: The Asteroid That Drops Diamond Rain Every 10 Years
hook: A metallic asteroid in the belt flashes with X-ray bursts every decade — and NASA thinks it's raining diamonds on its surface.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines wealth fantasy with sci-fi weirdness — high shareability due to 'diamond rain' hook.

title: The Classified NASA Video That Showed a Sphere Behind the Sun
hook: A declassified NASA SOHO video from 2012 reveals a massive black sphere orbiting behind the Sun — the agency never explained what it was.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual evidence plus government secrecy — the perfect storm for viral conspiracy curiosity.

title: The Great Filter That Already Wiped Out 99% of Life
hook: The Fermi Paradox has a dark answer: a planetary extinction event happens every 100 million years — and we're overdue.
why_this_can_go_viral: Timely and terrifying — implies our time is up. Hits the 'why haven't we found aliens' nerve.

title: The Solar Storm That Almost Turned Earth into Mars
hook: In 2012, a Carrington-class solar storm missed Earth by 9 days. If it hit, it would have stripped our atmosphere and boiled the oceans.
why_this_can_go_viral: Near-miss stories generate visceral 'what if' — turning Earth into Mars is a powerful visual.

title: The Dark Star That Orbits Our Sun Unseen
hook: A brown dwarf called Nemesis may circle the Sun every 26 million years, triggering mass extinctions — and it's coming back around.
why_this_can_go_viral: Classic hidden killer theory with a cyclical return — perfect for 'the end is coming' storytelling.
